key_events: Vance used his Rebar to draw the aggro of the elite guards at the sanctum entrance.
Rhea slammed the Null-Value Token into the locking mechanism, triggering a fatal exception that shattered the doors.
The party fought their way into the Sanctum Foyer, defeating the gilded constructs.
Vance sustained Heavy Blunt-Force Trauma from a stamp-hammer, dropping his HP to 2.
The Sanctum Foyer locked down, activating a lethal compliance grid.
A dismantled gilded construct began regenerating, forcing Vance to draw its aggro.
Rhea accessed the compliance terminal, which demanded a deposit of 150 System Credits.
Rhea deposited her Obsidian Shard, and Vance threw her his Copper Credits to make up the difference.
The terminal consumed the items, satisfying the check and deactivating the grid.
The blast door to the Audit Corridor opened, allowing the party to escape.
The party entered the Audit Corridor and was immediately targeted by automated turrets.
Vance blocked the incoming bureaucratic bolts with his Rebar, suffering severe durability loss.
Unit 734 warned of its impending critical system failure.
Rhea breached the final mahogany doors to confront the overseer.
The party successfully breached the inner office.
Vance drew the overseer's aggro but was immediately frozen by a Debt Lock.
Rhea utilized the Raw Data Packet and the residual code of the Null-Value Token to contest the overseer's action.
The system recognized the Formal Dispute, stalling the execution.
The overseer initiated a manual override to physically attack Rhea before the system could review the dispute.
Rhea utilized her remaining stamina to dodge the mana-infused strikes.
While evading, Rhea presented the Raw Data Packet and Null-Value Token, exposing the 14.3% skim and the divide-by-zero error.
The system's review reached 100% and validated Rhea's claims.
A catastrophic default was triggered on the overseer, immediately stripping his golden administrative shields.
The overseer mutated into a feral boss monster.
Vance's Debt Lock status effect was removed.
Rhea stowed the Raw Data Packet and Null-Value Token in her blazer pocket to free her hands.
Vance struck the overseer with his Rebar, dealing a critical hit and reducing the weapon's durability.
The party flipped the massive obsidian desk onto the overseer, dealing 14,800 environmental damage.
The feral overseer was killed, and the room began to shake as the node destabilized.
The feral overseer's death triggered a catastrophic structural collapse of the local node.
Rhea Mercer looted the Mercy Cache Coordinates (Mythic) from the overseer's desk.
Rhea Mercer looted the Administrative Residue Token (High-Tier) from the overseer's desk.
The System initiated a Frontier Zone Purge with a 30-second countdown.
Rhea stowed the newly acquired loot in her blazer pocket alongside her existing exploit items.
